EC1: Prior receipt of investigational anti-HIV vaccine
EC2: Ongoing therapy with any of the following: Systemic corticosteroids [OR]. Short course less than or equal to 21 days of [NOT] corticosteroids is allowed; Systemic chemotherapeutic agents [OR]; Nephrotoxic systemic agents [OR], including aminoglycosides [OR], amphotericin B [OR], cidofovir [OR], cisplatin [OR], foscarnet [OR], pentamidine [OR]; Immunomodulatory treatments [OR] including Interleukin-2; Investigational agents
EC3: Known allergy [OR]/sensitivity [OR] or any hypersensitivity to components of study drugs [OR] (ART) or their formulations
EC4: Active drug [OR] or alcohol [OR] use [OR] or dependence that would interfere with adherence to study requirements
EC5: Serious medical [OR] or psychiatric illness that would interfere with the ability to adhere to study requirements
EC6: Chronic or acute hepatitis B infection
EC7: Use of female hormonal products based on estrogen [OR] or derivatives
